name: College of Valor
summary: Skalds who fight in the front line and inspire heroic deeds.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.short: Medium armor, shields and martial weapons.
features.summary: You gain proficiency with medium armor, shields and martial weapons.

features.name: Combat Inspiration
features.short: Your inspiration can boost damage or AC.
features.summary: A creature with your Bardic Inspiration die can add it to a weapon damage roll it just made, or to its AC against one attack (as a reaction, after seeing the roll).

features.name: Extra Attack
features.short: Attack twice with the Attack action.
features.summary: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Battle Magic
features.short: After casting an action spell, attack as a bonus action.
features.summary: When you use your action to cast a bard spell, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.
